items.title: 9.5 Computing ke akhlaqi, qanooni aur mahoolyati asraat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu of topic 9.5 (PDF 135-137), paragraph for paragraph; the GDPR/PECA note, impacts figure, self-check and recap are ours.

blocks.text: Computing rozmarra zindagi ke bohat se pehluon par asar dalti hai. Technology ke ethical (akhlaqi) ya unethical (ghair-akhlaqi) asraat, legal (qanooni) ya illegal (ghair-qanooni) nataij ho sakte hain, aur yeh mahol (environment) par bhi asar dal sakti hai. Ethical istemal ka matlab hai digital tools use karte waqt munsifana aur zimmedarana faisle karna. Legal istemal technology se mutaliq qawaneen par chalta hai. Mahol par asar mein bijli ka kharch, electronic kachra (e-waste) aur fitrat par doosre asraat shamil hain. In asraat ka shaoor computing ke wasail use karte waqt samajhdari aur zimmedari ke faisle karne mein madad deta hai.
Technology ka ethical istemal

Technology ke ethical istemal ka matlab hai zimmedari se kaam karna aur digital amal se nuqsan na pohanchana. Is mein privacy, insaf aur maloomat ko sahi tarah sambhalne ka ehtram shamil hai. Ethical guidelines (akhlaqi rehnuma usool) par chalna online bharosa aur hifazat barqarar rakhta hai. Technology ke faislon mein logon, idaron aur muashre par mumkin asraat ka khayal rakhna chahiye. Digital tools ka zimmedarana istemal mehfooz aur munsifana digital mahol banata hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Ijazat ke baghair online content copy karna copyright laws aur digital ethics (akhlaqiyat) dono ki khilaf-warzi ho sakti hai.
Intellectual property aur data ownership ka ehtram

Intellectual property se murad takhleeqi kaam hai, jaise software, music ya tehreer (writing). Data ownership (data ki milkiyat) se murad apni zaati maloomat par control ka haq hai. In haqooq ke ehtram ka matlab hai ke ijazat ke baghair kisi ka kaam copy, share ya use na karein. Zaati aur hassas maloomat mehfooz rakhni chahiye aur us ka ghalat istemal nahi hona chahiye. Intellectual property aur data ka qanooni aur akhlaqi ehtram insaf ko barhata hai aur banane walon (creators) aur users dono ki hifazat karta hai.
Ghair-akhlaqi digital rawaiye ke nataij samajhna

Ghair-akhlaqi digital rawaiye mein hacking, jhooti maloomat phailana ya cyberbullying (online tang karna) shamil ho sakte hain. Aise kaam nuqsan pohancha sakte, saakh kharab kar sakte aur qanooni nataij la sakte hain. Online chhote kaam bhi bare asraat rakh sakte hain. Ghair-akhlaqi rawaiye ke nataij samajhna zimmedarana digital rawaiye ki himmat afzai karta hai. Akhlaqi miyar barqarar rakhna zyada mehfooz aur qabil-e-bharosa online mahol yaqeeni banata hai.
Qanooni pehlu aur data privacy laws

Computing ke qanooni pehluon se murad woh rules aur regulations (qawaid o zawabit) hain jo technology aur digital maloomat ke istemal par lagu hote hain. Cybercrime se murad computers, networks ya internet ke zariye kiye gaye ghair-qanooni kaam hain, jaise hacking, identity theft aur online fraud (dhoka-dahi). Yeh qawaneen afraad, idaron aur muashre ko data aur technology ke ghalat istemal se bachate hain. Data privacy laws yaqeeni banate hain ke zaati aur hassas maloomat zimmedari se jama, store aur share ho. In qawaneen ko samajhna qanooni masail se bachata hai aur mehfooz digital amal ko barhata hai. Qanooni dhanchon (legal frameworks) ki pabandi online systems aur services par bharosa bhi barhati hai.
Bain-ul-aqwami frameworks ka jaiza (maslan GDPR)

General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) European Union ka qanoon hai jo zaati data ki hifazat karta hai. Yeh qawaid tay karta hai ke idare data kaise jama, store aur use karein. GDPR transparency (shaffafiyat), consent (ijazat) aur zaati maloomat dekhne ya delete karwane ka haq lazmi karta hai. Bohat se mulk aur companies duniya bhar mein data privacy ke liye isi jaise miyar apnati hain. In frameworks ka maqsad zaati maloomat ke ghalat istemal ko rokna aur accountability (jawab-dehi) barhana hai.
Pakistan mein cybercrime laws aur data protection policies

Pakistan mein cybercrime rokne aur digital maloomat bachane ke qawaneen hain. Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act (PECA) 2016 Pakistan ka bunyadi qanoon hai jo cybercrime se nimatta hai. Is ka maqsad afraad, idaron aur riyasat ko computers, mobile devices aur internet ke zariye hone wale ghair-qanooni kaamon se bachana hai. Yeh qawaneen hacking, identity theft, online fraud aur data tak unauthorized access ko shamil karte hain. Idaron ke liye hassas maloomat bachane ki khatir data protection policies par chalna lazmi hai. Cybercrime aur data privacy laws torne par qanooni sazayein hain. In qawaid par chalna mulk ke andar digital systems mein hifazat aur bharosa barqarar rakhta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab se aage (aam ilm)
blocks.text: GDPR un idaron par lagu hai jo European Union ke logon ka zaati data sambhalte hain, un idaron samet jo EU se bahar hain, maslan Pakistani company, magar EU ke logon ko maal ya khidmat dete ya un ke rawaiye ki nigrani karte hain. PECA mein 2025 mein tarmeem hui; taaza shiqon ke liye sarkari matan dekhein.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Talaba ek rehnuma worksheet ki madad se PECA mein shamil cybercrimes ki list banayein.
Mahol aur muashre par asraat

Computing mahol aur muashre par kai tarah asar dalti hai. Technology bijli kharch karti, electronic kachra paida karti aur aloodgi (pollution) mein hissa dalti hai. Saath hi technology samaji rawaiye, baat-cheet aur saqafat (culture) par asar dalti hai. Mahol aur muashre par asraat samajhna digital tools ke zimmedarana istemal ko barhata hai. Sustainable (paidar) tareeqe aur muashre par asraat ka shaoor technology ko fitrat aur muashre ke saath tawazun mein rakhne ke liye zaroori hain.
E-waste management aur sustainable computing

Electronic waste (e-waste) tab banta hai jab devices phenk diye jate ya badal diye jate hain. E-waste ko ghalat tareeqe se thikane lagana mahol aur insani sehat ko nuqsan pohancha sakta hai. Sustainable computing mein electronic devices ko zimmedari se recycle karna, dobara use karna (reuse) aur kam karna (reduce) shamil hai. Kam bijli lene wale (energy-efficient) devices aur mahol dost tareeqe technology ka manfi asar kam karte hain. E-waste ka sahi intezam wasail bachata hai aur aloodgi kam se kam rakhta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Recycling, reuse aur energy-efficient devices mahol ka nuqsan kam karte hain.
Saqafati aur samaji tabdeeli mein technology ka kirdar

Technology badalti hai ke log kaise baat karte, kaam karte aur maloomat hasil karte hain. Social media, digital learning aur online services saqafat aur rozmarra zindagi par asar dalti hain. Technology taleem, sehat aur karobar ki karkardagi behtar kar sakti hai. Lekin yeh challenges bhi paida kar sakti hai, jaise digital divide (jin ke paas technology hai aur jin ke paas nahi, un ke darmiyan farq) ya privacy ka khatam hona. In samaji asraat ko samajhna muashre mein technology ke soch samajh kar aur zimmedarana istemal ki himmat afzai karta hai.

blocks.alt: Teen hisse: Akhlaqi (raazdari aur insaf; intellectual property ka ehtram), Qanooni (cybercrime par saza; GDPR (EU), PECA 2016 (Pakistan)), Mahoolyati (tawanai aur e-waste; reduce, reuse, recycle).
blocks.caption: Computing ke akhlaqi, qanooni aur mahoolyati asraat (is sabaq ke liye hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh tasveer nahi).

blocks.prompt: Talib-e-ilm na-maloom website se paisay wali kitab ka PDF download kar ke class group mein share karta hai. Is se kaun se akhlaqi, qanooni aur security masail paida hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Akhlaqi aur qanooni: ijazat ke baghair copy aur share kar ke publisher ki intellectual property aur copyright torta hai. Security: na-maloom sites ki files mein malware ho sakta hai jo kholne wale har shakhs tak phail jaye. Sahi amal sarkari ya library nuskha use karna hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Ethics: privacy, insaf, intellectual property aur data ownership ka ehtram; hacking, jhooti maloomat, cyberbullying se parhez.
Qanoon: GDPR (European Union) aur PECA 2016 (Pakistan) data bachate aur cybercrime par saza dete hain.
Mahol aur muashra: e-waste ka sahi intezam, recycle, reuse, reduce; digital divide aur privacy ka khayal.
